tier1_furling_reference/furling_compelle.notes: PASS 4: Aaron rejected all 6 generic furling_reference plates. These were placeholder LAYERED_INFO entries used as faction-level dialog avatars when no specific NPC existed. The Furling factions now have (or will have) named NPC avatars: Persuader=commander_halia, Cleanser=vael_souren, etc. COORDINATION QUESTION (game-design + lore): should the generic furling_reference plates be officially DEPRECATED in favor of named NPC avatars per faction? If yes, the LAYERED_INFO in tools/build_species_inventory.py should update the faction avatar_path entries to point at named-NPC avatars (e.g. COMPELLER_FACTION -> some named Compeller NPC, etc). Until then, this image is rejected but the system still references it; do NOT delete the file.
